proposal.summary: front/icon.send.php in the CMDB plugin for GLPI before 3.0.3 allows attackers to read sensitive information by supplying a _log/ pathname in the file parameter.
proposal.cwe_quote: allows attackers to gain read access to sensitive information via a _log/ pathname in the file parameter.

AV.quote: front/icon.send.php in the CMDB plugin before 3.0.3 for GLPI allows attackers to gain read access to sensitive information via a _log/ pathname in the file parameter.

C.quote: allows attackers to gain read access to sensitive information via a _log/ pathname in the file parameter.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Review and patch front/icon.send.php to validate and sanitize the file parameter (disallow path traversal and _log/ paths); if patch unavailable, block access to vulnerable endpoint and audit logs for unauthorized access to sensitive files.
